reader.failure_join: Exact captured headers vs complete serialized prefix and insertion-order ASCII byte length; captured headers may exceed serialized records, never manufacture missing records.

Reached marker alone does not require its own capture; a later M marker requires previous captured headers. Partial final marker is raw tail only.

writer.journal_encoding: ensure_ascii=True, separators comma/colon without spaces, insertion order, no sort; complete fixed4 list including null placeholders and brackets
writer.legacy_and_provider_shapes: Exactly unchanged from operative providerV2 branch
writer.size_omissions: Only own bounded builtin encoder ValueError or aggregate limit. Native/resource/endpoint exceptions propagate; complete diagnostic pair is never guaranteed.
